brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Hex bases assembled: full cell at 0,0,0/1 and half-w cells at 1,0,0/1 and 1,-1,0/1 forming 2-level shelving volume. Mesh clash clear. OPEN_CAP_FACE only info.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator validates only geometry/collisions, not materials, strength or load ratings. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; no load certification exists in system, so 50 kg rating cannot be verified.

Two notch drawer frames placed: notch:0#0,-1#notch5 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) and notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm). No drawer inserts (family drawer) were offered by find_sockets, so functional sliding drawers could not be added; frames provide drawer bays only.

finish.summary: Built 6-piece shelving base (clear mesh) with two drawer-frame notches. Load rating unmet - out of scope for configurator verification. Drawers partial: frames present, drawer inserts unavailable.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
